race.comment: LIEUTENANT DUNBAR (5) missed by 1.7L two back before a narrow defeat last start at Bunbury when beaten a head. The form out of that has been superb, with 2 winners from three subsequent starters already. Rates highly and can go one better this time. BLOWIN' SMOKE (6) drifted well back last start before storming home to score by 1.4 lengths over 1400m at this track. Has sound form at this track and distance with a win and two minor placings from four runs. Expected to be in the finish. DIVINE INANNA (1) is better than she showed last start and drops right back in grade today. Better suited here and she can run an improved race. SPARKLE CORNER (2) went forward from the low draw last time before fading to finish sixth over 1200m at this track. Cannot be underestimated. KEYTRADE (9) won't be far away on his recent form.
